plainText:
Fennel's Munna (Japanese: ドリーム Dream) is a studied by Fennel to help her understand the dreams of Pokémon.

==In the games==
=== ===
A Munna used in Fennel's research is encountered at the Dreamyard. After obtaining the , Fennel asks the to bring her some Dream Mist. However, Team Plasma also wish to obtain Dream Mist, and are abusing the Munna in order to achieve that end. After they have been defeated by the player and scared away by a wild , Fennel obtains the Dream Mist and Munna is saved. Bianca then tells the player that she will go look for the Pokémon they just saw, making it a possibility that this Munna is the one later appearing under the ownership of Bianca.

===Pokémon Dream World===
Fennel is the owner of a Munna in the Pokémon Dream World. This Munna, nicknamed ドリーム Dream in the Japanese version of the site, is seen when the player uses the demo version of the Dream World. Having no Pokémon of their own to send to the Dream World, they are instead accompanied by Dream. She has a Docile nature, was caught in a Premier Ball, and is at level 10.

===In events===
This Munna was distributed via serial code through the Pokémon Global Link to commemorate the closure of the service.

 
 
 

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
In , Fennel's Munna helps her with her research on the Dreamyard and .

==== ====
Fennel's Munna first appeared in Dreams by the Yard Full!, when had awakened , whereupon Fennel noticed her eyes were suddenly glowing pink. She was then seen with Fennel, helping Iris's Axew wake up by sucking off the Dream Mist caused by Musharna and revealing Axew's dreams in the process.

Later, , , Fennel, Munna, and Officer Jenny rushed to the Dreamyard, where they found out that Team Rocket had caused all of the problems. Munna summoned Musharna, though it was captured by Team Rocket. However, Munna used her to cripple the machine, giving a chance to destroy it with and free Musharna.

Munna reappeared with Fennel and Musharna in Archeops In The Modern World!, where the three of them were studying an . She helped stop from taking and .
